svg.text: Pipeline Architecture — 11 Agents | 4 Kill Gates | 6 Modes | 11 Controls
Smart Source Lists | Reddit Tiered Access | YouTube/Video Discovery | Beat Memory
Loads at start, updates at end
Scan all tiers, classify leads, extract blocked source intelligence
Draft 400-800 word research scaffolding per lead
Immediacy / Impact / Conflict / Novelty (1-5 each, threshold 10/20)
Produces: Reporter Task Memo + Visual Direction Brief + AI Prompts
Reddit deep-read + faint connections + cross-story links — NEVER publishable
4 Gates: Contestation → Adverse Search → Counter-Narrative → Self-Referential
Kill condition: counter-narrative more compelling = SUPPRESS
Attribution completeness, balance, harm assessment, legal flag
Per-story legal risk: defamation, SLAPP, prior restraint, source protection
150-200 word rewrites at 8th grade level for newsletters/social
SEO + Twitter/X + Facebook + LinkedIn + Nextdoor + Newsletter + Email
Agent 8: Source Hygiene + Headline Audit + Originality
Tier C contamination check | Status verb validation | 3-layer plagiarism
Kill: Tier C in attribution | Hold: originality FAIL
Beat Memory Update + Smart Source Proposals
Write threads, scores, suppression triggers, new source proposals
Section B: Verification Appendix (full agent output)
Community: Tip Prompts + Trust Dashboard + Pulse Check
All agents unabridged — no summarizing or truncating
New domains found → proposed with tier + context
.gov auto-add | Tier B/C need editor approval
Performance tracking: leads vs stories per source
Rejected sources logged to prevent re-proposal
City gov channel + Public access TV
